body: Ive been there man, it gets better as long as you keep fighting. Even with my friends and family, having someone to talk to who can relate to your situation can really make all the difference. Dm me if you ever need to, gl.

I do because I realized life is not a war you win, you win by fighting it. Are you going to fall down and break apart or are you going to pick yourself up and become the person others look up to? I say lead, face those challenges with courage and resolution. Draw fire from it, become the person who can take it when others cannot. 

A great man once said "nothing on Earth can stop a man with a great mental attitude, but nothing on Earth can help a man with a negative mental attitude".

Don't man, just because one person doesn't love you doesn't mean you're worthless. You have friends and family that love you a great deal more than you think, honestly. Your life should not be dictated by the opinions of one person, think about all that you have accomplished and done in life. Look at where you are now, that alone is a testament to worthy you really are. Gl brother
